title: London landmarks in a day
description: Four classics along the Thames, walkable in an afternoon. Drop a bugg at each to earn the badge.

spots.name: Tower Bridge
spots.why: The bascules lift a few times a week; check the bridge lift times.

spots.name: Borough Market
spots.why: London's oldest food market. Busiest at lunch, quieter on weekday mornings.

spots.name: Trafalgar Square
spots.why: Street performers, the lions and the National Gallery steps.

spots.name: Big Ben
spots.why: Best seen from Westminster Bridge, especially as the lights come on.
